Default markdown output format produces standard markdown

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"heading_style\":\"Atx\",\"output_format\":\"Markdown\"}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<h1>Title</h1><p>Some text.</p>", options)
    println(result)
}
```
